title: Unary count of decoded words
statement: For every bit string $w$, the count produced by testing, for each $i$ from $0$ through $|w|$, whether the second component remains nonempty after $i$ successive second-component projections is the unary word consisting of one true bit for each word in the recursive decomposition of $w$. This decomposition is empty for the empty word and otherwise begins with the first component of $w$, followed by the decomposition of its second component.
